name: ai-handoff-ledger
description: Records who did what in your project (you vs. which AI), whether you approved it, and hands the project's memory to the next AI.

commands.title: Handoff: Show a day in history (who worked, how long, on what)
Handoff: Switch AI and push memory
Handoff: Record an AI action I refused
Handoff: Add a guardrail for all AIs
Handoff: Open a task contract (goal, done-when, scope)
Handoff: Audit a contract (done vs asked vs out of scope)
Handoff: Wake an AI (editor or steward)
Handoff: Put an AI to sleep
Handoff: Tell the steward what to do (compile prompt and queue)
Handoff: Steward review (done vs asked vs scope)
Handoff: Register the MCP server for this workspace

handoff.ledgerPath.description: Ledger path, relative to the workspace root.

handoff.humanName.description: Your name in the ledger. Defaults to your OS user.

handoff.knownAis.description: AIs offered in the switch picker.

handoff.home.description: Machine-wide folder for providers, knowledge, projects and the remote password. Empty = ~/.handoff (or $HANDOFF_HOME).

handoff.watchFiles.description: Log file changes. Changes nobody claimed are recorded as 'unknown'.

handoff.idleMinutes.description: A gap longer than this many minutes between two actions of one AI starts a new session.

handoff.inferAttribution.description: Attribute unclaimed file changes to whichever AI you have declared in use, marked as 'inferred'. Turn off to leave them 'unattributed'.
